field.label: Typo Tolerance (Fuzziness)
field.comment: Lets a query with a typo ("joust dufle") still match ("Joust Duffle Bag"). AUTO allows one edit for words of 3 to 5 characters and two edits above; the first character must always match. Applies to the text fields of the search engine queries, suggestions included.

field.label: Minimum Query Length for Typo Tolerance
field.comment: Shorter queries are matched exactly; fuzzy matching on two or three characters returns noise.

field.label: SKU Match Weight
field.comment: Multiplier applied to the relevance of exact and partial SKU matches, so a product found by its SKU ranks above products found by a word of their description. 1 keeps the engine's weights.

field.label: Promoted SKUs
field.comment: Comma separated SKUs. When one of them matches a search query it is boosted to the top of the results (it is never added to results it does not match).

field.label: Promoted SKU Weight
field.comment: Relevance multiplier of the promoted products.

field.label: Stop Words
field.comment: Comma or space separated words removed from a search query before it runs ("the", "for", "shop"). The query is left untouched when only stop words remain. Per store view, so each language keeps its own list.

field.label: Fallback on Zero Results
field.comment: When a multi-word search has no result, the results page shows the products of the longest word that does match, the matching categories and the top-level categories instead of a dead end.

field.label: Products
field.comment: Products shown in the search dropdown (search engine results, best first; four fill one row of the desktop grid). 0 hides the section.

field.label: Popular Search Terms
field.comment: Query suggestions from the search terms of the store with their result counts. 0 hides the section.

field.label: Categories
field.comment: Active categories of the store whose name matches the query, shown with their path. 0 hides the section.
